title: TimeBank Prepaid Service Hours Installation Visit Hours
content:
**Visit considered.** The visit considered is the one on the client's ticket most recently resolved to the prepaid-block route with onsite labor, its date being that resolution's date, in the ClearPath Managed IT Services ticket history. Resolutions are stamped to the minute; where a business-hours and an after-hours onsite resolution carry the same minute the after-hours one counts as more recent, where two onsite resolutions of one class carry the same minute the one with more billable minutes counts as more recent, and where they also record the same billable minutes the one on the higher ticket number counts as more recent; a ticket is resolved once, so the ticket number ends every tie.

**Installation visit.** The visit is an installation visit when its ticket was opened in the service request category on or after the delivery date of the client's most recently delivered Hardware Procurement order, meaning the latest delivery date among the client's orders whose status is delivered, and no more than 14 calendar days after it, counting the delivery date as day 0. That order is the order the installation is priced on; where two delivered orders carry that latest delivery date, the one with more units is that order, and where they also carry the same units, the one with the higher quote number, the quote number being unique to each order. Every installation visit is priced from its own ticket's records and its order alone.

A visit that is not an installation visit is a service visit and is drawn under the service-visit rule, not this one; when the client has no onsite resolution routed to the block, or the block's ledger already carries an onsite-support draw for that ticket, no installation visit is figured.

**Block hours.** An installation visit on TimeBank Prepaid Service Hours draws its billable minutes, rounded up to the size's billing increment and never fewer than the size's onsite minimum, divided by 60, at the size's technician ratio and with a multiplier of 1, rounded half up to the hundredth of an hour, once, at the end.

Hypothetical cases on a TimeBank 80-Hour Block (15-minute increment, 60-minute onsite minimum): 200 billable minutes draw 210 minutes, 3.50 hours; 30 billable minutes draw 60 minutes, 1.00 hour. A service request ticket opened 14 days after the delivery date is an installation visit; one opened 15 days after it is not.
